description: This Java source file defines the class 'FinAccountPaymentServices', which provides various service methods related to financial account payments, such as authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment, within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles financial transactions, validations, and interactions with other services and entities associated with accounting and payment processing.

classes.name: FinAccountPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static service methods for managing financial account payments and transactions within the OFBiz framework, including authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment functionalities.

methods.name: finAccountPreAuth
methods.description: Performs pre-authorization of funds on a financial account, validating conditions such as account status, expiration, balance, and PIN, then creating an authorization transaction if conditions are met.

methods.name: finAccountReleaseAuth
methods.description: Releases or cancels a previously authorized transaction on a financial account.

methods.name: finAccountCapture
methods.description: Captures funds that were previously authorized, finalizing the transaction and deducting the amount from the account.

methods.name: finAccountRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund to a financial account, typically returning funds previously deposited.

methods.name: finAccountWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws funds from a financial account, subject to balance validation, and records the transaction.

methods.name: finAccountDeposit
methods.description: Deposits funds into a financial account, creating the appropriate transaction and updating balances.

methods.name: finAccountReplenish
methods.description: Automatically replenishes a financial account when the balance falls below a defined threshold by creating a replenishment order and deposit.

methods.name: getLastProductStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves the last used product store ID associated with the account for replenishment purposes.

methods.name: createFinAcctPaymentTransaction
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive financial account transaction, including payment creation and account transaction records, based on transaction type (deposit, withdrawal, adjustment).
